newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Park signs casino pact.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Park signs casino pact.

text.p: Hollywood Park Inc Friday said it signed a memorandum of understanding with the Yakama Indian Nation to build and operate a casino on Yakama land in Washington state.
The casino is expected to open late in the fourth quarter or early in 1998.

Under terms of the deal, Hollywood Park would lease land and finance construction of the 50,000 square foot casino. When it is built, the Yakama Nation would sublease the casino and hire Hollywood Park to provide consulting services.
The casino will be located just outside Yakima, Wash., about two-and-a-half hours southeast of Seattle and approximately the same distance from Portland, Ore.
